author: Kranthi M.
review_text: I have been using Zerodha for the past 2–3 years. Overall, I like the interface because it is clean and easy to use. However, one major issue I face is with placing stop-loss and target orders. There is no simple way to set the exact stop-loss and target that I want. In GTT orders, the platform often restricts stop-loss placement based on percentage or price conditions. Whenever I try to place a small stop-loss according to my trading strategy, it either rejects the order or displays conditions

author: Ashutosh M.
review_text: Worst support when you need it the most. Today, I added funds to my account. The amount was debited from my bank account but was not credited to my Zerodha account. To make matters worse, every customer support number I tried either disconnected after one ring or remained constantly busy. This is extremely frustrating, especially when timely support is critical. Based on my experience, I would not recommend using this app for trading.

author: Mohan P.
review_text: "It is a very basic application that constantly lags. Whenever I place an order, there is a significant delay in execution. Times have changed, but this application remains outdated with absolutely no upgrades. The user interface is terrible—first, I have to open the spot chart, then search for the strike price, then find the CE/PE, and finally place the buy/sell order. To check my positions, I have to go all the way back to the main tab. Even the charts are useless as they don't show the Stop L

author: Abhinay S.
review_text: My experience with Zerodha Kite has been mixed. The app interface is clean, smooth, and very easy to use, which makes trading convenient even for beginners. However, the charges feel a bit high, including annual fees and other hidden costs that are not always clear. It would be better if pricing was more transparent. Overall, good usability but costs could be lower.

author: Google Play User
review_text: What is happening with your app now?? Im loosing money because of your lagging app or slow server. I buy a stock and it shows up with so much delay. By the time it shows up in positions, the SL has already hit . So much lagging every now and then. Whats going on??! This isnt the first time happening. My internet is very fast FYI. This has been happening since a week now! I'm planning to cancel the account and open somewhere else.

author: Sourav M.
review_text: The latest version is very slow. The charts never load for some stocks. The 3 dots keep on going as per the animation but chart never loads for some. There is no issue in the internet speed as other apps and all are working fine. Please fix this. If we can't see the charts what the point of having them then in the app if we can't see them in real-time.

author: Harsha B.
review_text: I started my trading journey with Zerodha. I started from the very basics to becoming a full time trader. All I can say is that it is good for the normal delivery and intraday trading. When it comes options trading, there is no limit order for current option expiry and no market order for future option expiry which does not make any sense. It's like according to their whims and fancies, sometimes it works and sometimes they just remove. They are just not bothered. Otherwise it's good.

author: jay j.
review_text: From last 2/3 months it's hell of a experience to use kite application. Charts never loads. Just never. Pathetic. I waited a lot that, in your updates problem will resolve but it never happened. Also option chain opening takes lot of time.! Even in search it gets hanged.! Give stability or will have to close the account. Edit : I have 100 Mbps internet speed from two different service providers and using it with load balancing router. So issue is DEFINITELY from your side.

author: Dharani S.
review_text: Just waste of time. Lots of glitches, have been fighting to open the account more than a week. Every time it starts from the beginning and fails in between. Finally I managed to complete but didn't get any response more than 3 days. I created a ticket, you know what the reply was? 'please try again' I got fainted. Please don't reply with a template message `Please create ticket.... ` I am writing this review after creating the ticket.

author: Jagadesh (.
review_text: Don't why much of formalities in account opening. Other apps are much quicker and easier. And I lost almost 1.8k in a useless way. I had bought and sold some shares with some profit in intraday. Later the same day some shares are automatically bought and automatically squared off with loss of 1.8k. I don't what happened though. Bad experience. Switching to the previous app I used to trade. #ByeZerodha Edit: Create ticket? But when I used to click on that it just show some FAQs.

author: Gourav S.
review_text: Though app is fine but few problems are there which must be fixed. 1. This does not work instantly and there is a time lag when logged in. Comparatively, few other apps of broking cos work very fast. 2. There is no info on top gainer / loser. No details for change in F&O data. 3. Its difficult to access option chains and takes a lot of time. Its better to switch to other app to analyse option chains.

author: Punit S.
review_text: I used to think this was a good app, but not anymore. I've been encountering so many technical issues. At first, the chart would get stuck on the very first stock I checked during the day, but now it's even worse. I can't place a GTT limit order, and it's showing a plus sign (+) in the stop loss and a minus sign (-) in the target. That's not all—when I tried to fix it, the app didn't accept the order. Then, when I submitted it as it was, the order was executed and I lost most of the profit. 😤

author: Debojit c.
review_text: Worst app I've ever used. I don't know how people recommend this app. Everytime u order at market price it executes at higher then market price, u have to refresh every time after changing the lot size or price. Even opening the option chain takes lot of time. And if u want to go back to option chain after opening a strike, you'll be redirected to the overview page. It's a time consuming app. And also it have lot of rules and regulations that other apps don't, lot of restrictions like u can't or

author: Kaveri B.
review_text: Everything was fine for the last couple of years. But for the last couple of months we cannot view the Chart for any company properly. It only shows the "loading" icon going round and round. If we change it from portrait to landscape mode, or vice versa, it then shows the chart for 1 day, week, month, 3 months, and 6 months. But nothing beyond that. Even if we ask for 1, 3, or 5yrs, only the last 6 months of data is shown. If we select "ALL", then the graph goes beserk. For ALL companies.

author: Google Play User
review_text: Horrible Horrible app. More often than not there is always lagging in placing the order. Some placed order is not visible until 10 min. If the price breaches the ordered level, it may not buy or sell in such situations. same happened with my stop-loss today and it got hanged, suffered big loss by the time it was corrected . On top of it, forget about the customer care number during market hours when you need them most, they will not be reachable at all. In short very unprofessional, unapologetic

author: Ashok G.
review_text: Everything was fine during FY 2022-23, but suddenly, from the current FY, it started sudden and frequent breakdowns of all services, particularly during a peak hour session. Not only that, but sometimes I feel that there is something awkward happening behind the scenes in option trading. I feel something suspicious is happening. Approaching to the support team is another tedious and too much time taking.

author: Jai A.
review_text: Overall, ease of trading is just better on other platforms. It is super fast than all the apps, but there can be multiple suggestions. One being : - While Buying, can you show current funds, and how much total quantity value is, it is super frustrating, to go back, check exact value to one digit, and then enter exact quantity. So many user experience wise issues. Hire a good UX guy.

author: veeras D.
review_text: There is too much lag in order execution. Even when the stock reaches the target price, buy/sell orders are not getting executed on time. At market end, it sometimes feels like the system behaves unpredictably, almost like gambling with execution. Auto-trigger orders frequently move in the opposite direction of the intended trade and often pick the wrong side, resulting in missed opportunities or unfavorable execution.

author: Ankur V.
review_text: I am highly disappointed with the app and the website. On the other hand I cancelled an order, went out to buy grocery and then came back to see that order went through. It has happened for the second time. Issue was reported on the first instance and there was no response till date. Do not trust their account managers; they are good while account opening but once done, they won't even answer to your calls.

author: anpadko
review_text: The app is good enough. But there is no report where we can see proper break up of "other credits and debits". Referring to multiple reports of tradebook PnL and cash book to understand actual cost of making transactions is confusing. Please make a single report having a separate line for each purchase, sale, brokarage, and other charges. The net settlement report is of no use to get all the above details.

author: rohit k.
review_text: Tried to cancel an order before it was triggered, wouldn't let me complete the request ( Kept saying validating request), then suddenly the order was triggered. Wanted to sell the order at the buy price so that I dont lose anything, but the app wouldn't let me do that either. Now lost more than 8k in just 1 min due to their technical fault. Never using it again. Gonna withdraw everything and switch to another platform. Download app at your own risk coz there's a lot of technical issues.

author: Google Play User
review_text: Very poor customer support system!! Its been more than a month that i am trying to get in touch with someone. The person who helped to open the account completely disappeared after opening my account (Target should have been met). I generally don't write very harsh feedback since I know how difficulty behind customer service (I do work for the service industry). But this very poor and very bad.

author: Google Play User
review_text: Review update after a year usage -"All good things come to an end!". So does zerodha. 1* for the bugs and issues . NOTHING CHANGED IN THE LAST ONE YEAR. Too many bugs. The data stops updating randomly, LTPS's stop updating, charts dont load. have to open and kill the app multiple times that is when it starts loading. Option trading is very volatile and if the app stops working randomly inbetween it is risky for the user. There were a couple of times when i lost money only because the data froze.

author: Suman S.
review_text: This app has started deducting money discreetly for buy orders too. I have been observing since last several times that is does not only charge ₹15 for every selling which is clearly shown on the transaction, it started deducting money, more than ₹15,for every buy order too., which has no mention anywhere. The balance amount at the end of transaction day changes the next day. There is no mention of the diff. of the amount where it disappeared. Be careful guys and keep track of your money here.

author: Sunny Y.
review_text: I have noticed a few issues with order execution on Kite. In one case, I placed a buy order with a limit price of ₹155.20 and a trigger price of ₹155.30, but the order was executed when the price was around ₹155.00. This was unexpected and needs clarification.Similarly, I placed a stop-loss at ₹140.00, but it was triggered when the price was around ₹140.20. This behavior can be confusing for traders.I request the Kite team to improve transparency around order execution.

author: Google Play User
review_text: The developers probably spend 0 brains on the app. There was a stupid ad when I created an ad. And then when I tried to skip the app, I had to reregister. But guess what? It says email or mobile number already exists. I had not even verified the number. It says registered. Now I cannot login or even register. Have the developers heard about edge cases?

author: Vikas N.
review_text: I had around Rs. 35,000 in my Zerodha fund account on Feb 5, 2021, and now it's showing Rs -15000 after settlement. I was not able to close the position due to your technical glitch in the application as well in your website. I called your customer support team immediately multiple times and none of them was bothered to pick my call. What is the point of getting a loss of Rs 50,000 (approx) because of your mistake. Therefore, I kindly request to refund my deducted amount as soon as possible.

author: Google Play User
review_text: Everything is good, i am just not happy with the changes made in Charts. Previously i was able to see chart for 5 years or all time chart, using my smartphone. But, i am currently able to see chart for 1 year only, and when i zoom out i can go up to 2 years. I request you to change this to the previous settings as it may be used by most of the long term investors to see more historical data (charts for more that 2 years).

author: anil p.
review_text: App is good but I suggest from my side that while placing nifty or bank nifty order there must show the chart price so that we can apply the order. While ordering we check repeatedly that is it crossed over level or not. Because of this we lose the right entry at right time. And I don't know how to add candle timing is this option is there or not.

author: Subhash R.
review_text: The chart in trading view is quite irritating. the details are not displaying on the mobile screen nor that is scrolling to select ok. Overall the app is ok. but the worst thing is that the alert interface and font color. i advise to provide a simple ring alert on target, trigar which a trader wishes to at a specific price. secondly , the red font color under sun light is not quite visible. so i advise to give an option to choose day light color(Yellow in fall) for clear visibility.

author: David R.
review_text: Extremely frustrating account opening process. I've paid the account opening fee and it has been debited from my account. However, the process was not moving forward. Now it is asking me to pay again. Raised complaints......It has been more than a week no way ahead..... Very bad customer service. Probably account opening is a BIG SCAM as multiple customers have faced the same issue without being resolved. Truly disappointed and extremely bad customer service.

author: HARJEET S.
review_text: after completion of sign-up process and paying 200 bucks, I didn't receive my userid and password. it's been more than a week. the most pathetic customer support. don't go with zerodha. I have sent 20 emails almost. but no solution. every time they say that your esign process hasn't completed but I have completed it so many times and sent you the attachment of the last screen. I have done everything I could. I will never recommend such an app which can't find the problem in account opening.

author: iTz m.
review_text: The app was good earlier, now it has become slow, 1. login will take time. 2. The chart won't load properly. 3. The worst is the tijori integration, Tijori data is not up to date in the so called "widget" section and we need to go to "view more info" to see the correct data, which forces us to login to tijori ( obviously share our kite financial data with them ). I was seriously thinking about switching.

author: Praveen M.
review_text: I have been using the Kite app for the last 8 years, it was good but from the last 2 weeks, I am unable to open charts of many stocks it just shows the loading icon and unable to select the time frame 1 day, 5 mins etc..I thought there might be fixes but no resolution

author: H B.
review_text: Very good compared to other trading apps. The newly added Trailing Stop-Loss feature is one of the best features among all trading platforms. Along with price alerts, it makes trading much easier, safer and more disciplined. These features give the app a clear edge over other trading apps and, in my opinion, make it one of the superior trading platforms in the Indian market.

author: SAMARTH J.
review_text: App is really good. I like it. I use it for my all Stock Investing. It will be really good if we will be able to see below things on chart along with other Financial events. Existing Event visible on chart: 1. Dividend 2. Stock Split Extra Invents as per users: 1. Shares sold- Qty and Price 2. Shares Bought - Qty and Price 3. Current Invested amount and % Gain or Loss on current Investment of that stock ( On top of screen )

author: Chandan S.
review_text: In my experience, Zerodha feels like an app designed for people who have plenty of time and patience. I recently needed to correct a simple spelling mistake in my nominee’s name. What should have been a simple online update turned into a long process involving emails, printing documents, filling them out, signing/e-signing, uploading them through the support portal, and repeatedly following up. Even after all this, the update is still under process. #291833

author: harshad k.
review_text: Application is good, but little slow as compared to live market. While I was watching Television i saw that market movement is ahead and in zerodha it's showing late. First i thought it might be due to internet issues, but it was same with mobile connection or WiFi. @Zerodha need to fix this issue.

author: BISWAJIT P.
review_text: I cannot use a stop-loss order in the system. There is an option called GTT; when I use it, the GTT gets triggered, but the lot I purchased does not actually sell—it shows as "Sell Canceled" and remains listed under "Open Orders." I have to go there, cancel that open order first, and only then can I sell the lot I bought. I am requesting that this issue be fixed.

author: Fagilu R.
review_text: not so informative app. for trading its not at all good. just covers the basic. no screeners. even the option chain screen is under utilized. there is literaly no home screen, you need to search every single stock to know whats happening. if a stock is at 52w low. we dont know. if a stock is up 10% we dont know. unless you type the stock and search it. hardly the bare minimum attention given to the app. for trading upstox is the best. for investing groww is the best.

author: Jaydeep P.
review_text: Totally fraudulent app. The customer team has no knowledge of anything; everyone answers differently. They are just passing time. Even after 24 hours of ticket creation, they don't know what to do to solve the ticket. Please think before opening an account. They will just waste time, and in the end, the customer will bear the loss, even if the fault was from Zerodha.

author: Pankaj K.
review_text: dear Kite team, i requested you that recently updated kite is not better due to during the modification of stop loss and target intermittent open order place windows kindly update to drag and confirm option is available on chart then click all are set automatic...

author: MATH, E.
review_text: please introduce the option of "trade book" and "profit loss" of each stock in that particular stock just below the "view breakdown" option of that particular stock, simultaneously as usual with console, then the customer will be benefited to look the "trade book" and "profit loss" of the particular stock quickly & instantly and calculate his profit and loss quickly for further trade of that stock. I request to the developer of the kite app to rectify the issue as soon as possible.

author: Karan B.
review_text: Stop loss facility is missing. like in some other platforms if I open trade then already I have set my sl and tp. like 10% . then automatically sl and tp apply. but in zerodha we have to do it manually after opening position and in fast moving market it creates fear. kindly implement.

author: Vikram M.
review_text: Worst app for withdrawal money. Other brokers are not even taking 1 day for money withdrawal. Mentioned this point based on experience.Don't know what is the use of instant withdrawal if it takes 1 day to 2 days. Missing so many IPOs because of late withdrawal. Getting a doubt is broker misleading the retailers money.

author: Swapnal S.
review_text: Very bad loading. Most of the time charts get break. Auth takes so much of time. most of the time api fetch gets timeout. Even after reinstalling it always gets crashed. Chart always failed to load. Always I have to reload multiple times to get data. Worthless brokerage app.

author: AJAY S.
review_text: Zerodha team, please add direct on chart order modification! Currently, trailing stoploss and targets requires going back to the order book repeatedly. It should be easy and instant. Kindly introduce a feature to drag-and-drop stoploss and target levels directly on the chart, just like other platforms. This single change will make the trading experience much faster and user friendly.

author: Manan K.
review_text: I'm not sure, if the app is sharing the financial data with third parties, or is it not as secure as they claim to be. I tried to set up online - but due to a technicality the setup was not completed - which I was informed after they had processed all perosnal information. I thought of trying at a different time. But ever since doing that, I'm constantly recieving fraudulent phone calls.

author: Yash
review_text: every other button opens a link, whereas link of a share or ipo can't be shared directly! another reviewer ashutosh also noted that requires to leave app for every other functionality even alerts. can't add MF to watchlist. tap-&-hold doesn't show labels for most of button-icons. can't use system theme (day/dark). my peer rightly suggested zerodha's interface is needlessly complicated.

author: rao G.
review_text: They are absolute crooks; they charge exorbitant fees. Once you deposit funds, they deduct everything. There is no customer service; no one responds. It is the worst app. If anyone is looking to open an account right now, there are many other apps available that are free and far better than this one. worst app👎👎

review_text: lots of issues in the app , it does not support options trading on charts like other apps , it should include it as it's great to have it . lags are there always. to trigger buy or sell everytime we have to go to other tabs .

author: Parthasaradhi R.

I hope these kind of issues will be solved as soon as possible

Plus, after paying with UPI, I'm not getting sent back to finish signing up. Because of all these problems, I'm just gonna use a different app.

author: Tipu M.
review_text: while purchasing two times otp is not required but while selling it needs two times otp and the OTP doesn't comes quickly it takes time and the prices hirs up. and I can't see my transaction at one platform i need to download excel and it's so much confusing. other trading aps give everything clear all history at one page which all share i had purchased and which all shares sold date time and profit details everything at one page but here I need to generate the report manually which is not good.

review_text: accidental logging out due to poor ux, navigating back during login page is logging me out, then i have to login again, it does ask, but whyyy logout is hidden there??, its annoying, you should put the logout option somewhere else.

review_text: App is smooth. Minimal with No ads or annoying pop ups or loans and UPI things like the competitors. But the app experience is not good. Tijori's fundamental integration is very bad, We have to move to a browser for that and also the in app summary doesn't have a proper dark mode with laggy navigation. for MFs we have to move to the Coin app many like me want a all in one app. 2/5 For now.

review_text: changed to 4 star because of high integrity in operations. buy popup defaulting to iceberg causing false/large order creation instead of regular. hide iceberg somewhere else or provide option to block, are people actually using it or you created this for 3 people ? please provide F&O physical delivery charges/cost calculator. no example for delivery on website was surpring for me.

author: Arnav P.

Groww does MF better, charts better, Cards better. Wake up Zerodha. This is embarrassing.

author: Jeeva M.

author: Aatif
review_text: Developers need attention here 🚨 -chart drawing limitations -no sort savings -missing chart open through alerts -slow chart loading -missing bulk import features -missing on chart alerts -missing watchlist scan & sharing

author: Sunil M.
review_text: due to double click exit/cancel position, many times position get immediately selled in market price in loss. previously it was good for pop up generate for cancel or exit.

author: Sandeep S.
